opportunities.account: Sam E Mitchell Jr. Associate Inc

opportunities.loss_detail:
Hi Patrick,

Thank you for reaching out to us and walking us through the platform. I spoke with the team, and we've come to the consensus that we are not ready to make the jump yet. I'd like to circle back to this conversation in year or so when we are better situated internally to make another transition. For now, we will focus on making Halo work and if things don't go well, we'd like to continue where we left off.

Thanks again,
Alan

Alan sent this email - pushed back but haven't heard back from him

Philip was hung up one the ability to automatically pass detailed scopes of work from opportunities/quotes/proposals to the generated work order ticket. We pressed on this and committed to adding it to the roadmap/accelerating it if they chose us as their solution, but he would not consider us for further evaluation

He met with Brook at ScaleCon and really wanted to see a demo of the platform before we're available in the Pax8 marketplace (slated for Q1 according to Usman). He is a one man shop and the price is ultimately too high, but he's looking forward to when that becomes available.

Called Mark to confirm meeting and user count and he said he only need 3-5 users. He thinks 1k is to much at this time wehn he was looking to spend $400-$500 a month if it helped his billing Intermedia does all the usage/taxation today then he receives it and puts his mark up on it. He want's this to be more automated but right now we do not receive the invoices from Intermedia. Pricing seems to be to high anyways so closing this one out.

Having difficulties with communication billing, but only billing around 9-12k MRR and 1k would be to much at this time. His connectwise Contract is up in February 2028 and that's when it could make more sense.

Teri & Leonard declined to share SSN and DL info. Let them manually enter in payments for a bit and reengage during Q1. 
Only $3K in cc volume.
Client just moved and wants to hold off until the end of the year before making a move.

Wanted to gather information on the reseller model and the new platform, but is more closely evaluating quoting for resellers before billing for resellers. New platform needs to be multi-tenant to git htat use case, so will reconnect closer to new year when they're closer to implementing reseller billing.
